# Psalm 5 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 5:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Give-ear-to my-words, YHWH; consider my-groaning.
- **LOGOS:** Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.
- **PNEUMA:** Listen to my words, LORD. Hear my sighing.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** You-destroy speakers-of falsehood; a-man of-blood and-deceit YHWH abhors.
- **LOGOS:** You destroy those who speak lies; the LORD abhors the man of blood and deceit.
- **PNEUMA:** You destroy liars. The LORD detests murderers and deceivers.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 5:9 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** YHWH, lead-me in-Your-righteousness because-of my-enemies; make-straight before-me Your-way.
- **LOGOS:** Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make Your way straight before me.
- **PNEUMA:** Lead me in Your righteousness, LORD, because of those who lie in wait for me. Clear a straight path ahead of me.

## 5:12 (overlap: 4%)

- **EMET:** But-let-rejoice all who-take-refuge in-You; forever let-them-sing-for-joy. And-You-shelter over-them, and-let-exult in-You those-who-love Your-name.
- **LOGOS:** But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever sing for joy. Spread Your protection over them, that those who love Your name may exult in You.
- **PNEUMA:** But let all who take shelter in You be filled with joy! Let them sing for joy forever. Protect them, so that those who love Your name may celebrate in You.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 5:11 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** Hold-them-guilty, O-God; let-them-fall by-their-own counsels; in-the-multitude of-their-transgressions drive-them-out, for they-have-rebelled against-You.
- **LOGOS:** Make them bear their guilt, O God; let them fall by their own counsels. Because of the abundance of their transgressions, cast them out, for they have rebelled against You.
- **PNEUMA:** Declare them guilty, O God. Let their own schemes be their downfall. Drive them away for their many sins, because they have rebelled against You.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 5:8 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** But-I, in-the-abundance of-Your-steadfast-love, I-enter Your-house; I-bow-down toward Your-holy temple in-Your-fear.
- **LOGOS:** But I, through the abundance of Your steadfast love, will enter Your house. I will bow down toward Your holy temple in the fear of You.
- **PNEUMA:** But because of Your great unfailing love, I can come into Your house. I bow before Your holy temple in reverent awe.
